record.field: Crown Fine Art Museum - Enable/disable views

website = env.ref('museum.website_industry')
to_deactivate = [ # Presets 'portal.user_sign_in', 'website.header_text_element', 'website_event.opt_event_calendar_block', 'website_event.opt_event_organizer_block', 'website_event.opt_event_share_block', # Default static pages 'website.homepage', 'website.contactus', ]
to_activate = [ 'website.template_header_default_align_center', 'website.template_header_navlink_no_background', 'website_event.opt_event_description_cover_top', 'website_sale.header_hide_empty_cart_link', ]
ctx = {'website_id': website.id}
for xml_id in to_deactivate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': False}) for xml_id in to_activate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': True})
menus = env['website.menu'] base_domain = [('website_id', '=', website.id)] top_menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('parent_id', '=', False)], limit=1)
# Menu items added by installed modules menus.search(base_domain + [('url', 'in', ['/shop', '/event', '/appointment'])]).unlink()
# Menu items of the design, in navbar order. for name, url, sequence in [ ('HOME', '/', 10), ('EXHIBITIONS', '/exhibitions', 20), ('VISIT', env.ref('museum.event_event_4').website_url, 30), ('CONTACT US', '/contactus', 40), ]: menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', url)], limit=1) if menu: menu.write({'name': name, 'sequence': sequence}) else: menus.create({ 'name': name, 'url': url, 'sequence': sequence, 'website_id': website.id, 'parent_id': top_menu.id if top_menu else False, })
